items.title: Stock Radar: Leela Palace stock hits fresh record highs in August 2026; time to buy or book profits?
items.description: Leela Palace Hotels stock broke a bullish pattern, suggesting higher prices ahead. Experts recommend buying the stock for a target of Rs 570. The stock has shown improvement in its price structure and uptrend. Traders can consider a stop loss at Rs 495 for risk management.

items.title: Supreme Court rulings set to raise insurers' third-party liability
items.description: General insurers face higher motor third-party claim reserves due to Supreme Court rulings. A recent ruling fixes homemakers' notional income, increasing claim payouts. This interpretation is expected to raise claim outgo significantly over eighteen months. Insurers also face policy standardization for occupant and pillion-rider coverage. Motor third-party insurance remains challenging with rising claim costs and slow premium growth.
